en.title: HAMNET
en.subtitle: ARABIC
en.synopsis: "1580 England. Impoverished Latin tutor William Shakespeare meets free-spirited Agnes, and the pair, captivated by one another, strike up a torrid affair that leads to marriage and three children. Yet as Will pursues a budding theater career in far-away London, Agnes anchors the domestic sphere alone. When tragedy strikes, the couple’s once-unshakable bond is tested, but their shared experience sets the stage for the creation of Shakespeare’s timeless masterpiece, Hamlet. From Focus Features and Academy Award® winning filmmaker Chloé Zhao (Nomadland, The Rider) comes a sensitively observed, magnificently crafted tale about the complexities of love and the healing power of art and creativity.Stars Jessie BuckleyPaul MescalZac Wishart"

brands.company_name_en: Gulf Brand For Fast Food CO
brands.description_en:
The Gulf Brand Fast-Food Company (GBFF), exclusive master franchisee of the US fried chicken giant Popeyes, has opened its fourth restaurant in Riyadh. 
After opening its first Popeyes restaurant on Anas Bin Malik Street in Riyadh which offers a bright and vibrant family-friendly atmosphere and a convenient Drive thru, GBFF opened two cloud kitchens restaurants, and its latest restaurant on Imam Saud Road in Massif, Riyadh. Guests can look forward to enjoying Popeyes world-famous products, such as the brand’s signature Chicken Sandwich, Chicken on the bone, and Tenders, perfectly marinated for 12 hours in a unique blend of Louisiana seasonings.
Founded in New Orleans in the United States in 1972, Popeyes has over 45 years of history and culinary tradition with over 3,600 locations in more than 25 countries. Popeyes is one the world’s largest chicken quick-service restaurants serving chicken dishes in bold and spicy flavors. 


Popeyes introduces for the first time in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia its hero Sandwich “The SANDWICH” which comes to you along with the whole menu items 100% local and fresh sourced chicken from Tanmiah Farms.
GBFF is planning to open hundreds of new Popeyes restaurants in the Kingdom over the coming years.
The Popeyes restaurant with mouth-watering crunchy and juicy fried chicken bursting with Louisiana flavor can quickly establish itself as a lifestyle-led hospitality leader. The new restaurant is designed with the precise needs of the cosmopolitan Saudi market in mind to bring a unique, world-class addition to the Kingdom’s ever-evolving dining scene. 
GBFF aims to make Popeyes available to guests in every place in the Kingdom through digital platforms, including the mobile app & website.
Gulf Brand Fast-Food Company’s strategy to develop the Popeyes presence in the Kingdom will allow it to create hundreds of career opportunities and share the joy of Popeyes with the people of Saudi Arabia.

Ateej is a contemporary fragrance brand offering rich Arabian‑inspired perfumes that blend traditional oriental notes with modern aromatic touches, creating distinguished scents designed to leave a lasting impression

Ibraq (originally Ibrahim Al-Qurashi) is a heritage Saudi Arabian perfume house rooted in the traditional art of perfumery since 1929. Starting from a modest shop near the Holy Mosque in Makkah, the brand expanded to Jeddah and across the Gulf, blending Arabic fragrance heritage with contemporary craftsmanship to create oud, amber, musk, and bespoke perfume blends that celebrate luxury and authenticity. Today, Ibraq is considered one of the leading perfume brands in Saudi Arabia and the Gulf region.

Saudi Investment Bank (SAIB) is a major Saudi commercial bank offering a full range of personal, corporate, investment and retail banking services — including accounts, cards, loans, home and auto finance, treasury solutions, and Shariah-compliant products. SAIB also operates a large network of ATMs throughout Saudi Arabia to provide convenient banking and self-service transactions.
